class.name: ht_ros2_control/PantheraHardwareInterface
class.description: Panthera-HT hardware interface driven by motor_cpp (one hightorque_robot::robot). Single arm uses 7 motors; dual arm uses 14. Motor count comes from YAML + joint layout. Velocity commands are passed through as feedforward (0 when not written); kp/kd are managed by hardware + ROS parameters (tunable via rqt), not exported as command interfaces. All blocking SDK serial calls run on a background IO thread.
